name: Ethan James Walker
title: Junior Game Developer
summary: Junior game developer with hands-on experience building gameplay systems, UI features, and bug fixes in Unity and Unreal Engine. Known for collaborating with artists and designers to deliver polished prototypes, optimize performance, and support reliable release cycles.

bullets: Implemented 12+ gameplay and UI features for a mobile action title, improving level completion rate by 8%.
Resolved 40+ high-priority bugs across gameplay, animation, and HUD systems during live update cycles.
Worked with designers to tune enemy behavior and player progression, reducing early-session drop-off by 11%.
Built prototype mechanics for 4 internal concepts in Unity, cutting iteration time by 20% through reusable systems.
Added save/load, input remapping, and pause menu functionality for a PC puzzle game shipped to closed beta.
Participated in daily reviews and sprint planning, helping close 95% of assigned tasks on schedule across 6 sprints.
Supported a 6-person team by implementing minor gameplay scripts, UI interactions, and debug tools in Unreal Engine.
Tracked and reproduced 30+ defects in Jira, improving turnaround time for QA-verified fixes.
Assisted with build validation and playtest prep, contributing to 2 milestone releases without missed deadlines.
Developed 3 portfolio projects for coursework and showcase events using Unity and C#, including a 2D platformer and top-down arena game.
Collaborated with 4 classmates on version control, feature integration, and playtesting feedback loops.
Optimized scene loading and object pooling in a capstone project, reducing frame drops by 15% on mid-range laptops.
